description: Estimates the CO₂ from flying hours in one or more aircraft types: one row for a pilot, several rows for a fleet (a school, club or operator). CO₂ = hours × the type’s kg of CO₂ per flight hour, from its fuel flow at about 75% power. Types match by name, ICAO type designator or page slug.

aircraft.description: A name, ICAO type designator or page slug

period.description: "year" when the hours are per year, "total" for a one-off total
